title: Christ Our Hope in Life and Death
lyrics_original: What is our hope in life and death?
Christ alone, Christ alone.
What is our only confidence?
That our souls to Him belong.
Who holds our days within His hand?
What comes, apart from His command?
And what will keep us to the end?
The love of Christ, in which we stand.
O sing hallelujah!
Our hope springs eternal;
O sing hallelujah!
Now and ever we confess
Christ our hope in life and death!
What truth can calm the troubled soul?
God is good, God is good.
Where is His grace and goodness known?
In our great Redeemer’s blood.
Who holds our faith when fears arise?
Who stands above the stormy trial?
Who sends the waves that bring us nigh
Unto the shore, the rock of Christ?
O sing hallelujah!
Our hope springs eternal;
O sing hallelujah!
Now and ever we confess
Christ our hope in life and death!
Unto the grave, what shall we sing?
“Christ, He lives; Christ, He lives!”
And what reward will heaven bring?
Everlasting life with Him.
There we will rise to meet the Lord,
Then sin and death will be destroyed,
And we will feast in endless joy,
When Christ is ours forevermore.
O sing hallelujah!
Our hope springs eternal;
O sing hallelujah!
Now and ever we confess
Christ our hope in life and death!
O sing hallelujah!
Our hope springs eternal;
O sing hallelujah!
Now and ever we confess
Christ our hope in life and death!

bible_verses.english: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my ultimate hope in every season of life and in death. Forgive me for the times I place my confidence in worldly things instead of Your enduring love. Help me to rest deeply in the truth that my soul belongs to You and that nothing can snatch me from Your hand. Teach me to walk courageously today, singing hallelujah in full assurance of Your eternal grace. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: In a world filled with constant change and uncertainty, "Christ Our Hope in Life and Death" grounds our souls in an unshakable truth: we belong to Jesus. Every day of our lives—and even our final breath—is held securely in the gentle, sovereign hands of our Savior. As we sing these truth-filled words, we are invited to surrender our anxieties and rest in His unwavering love. Let your heart rise in joyful praise, knowing that our eternal hope is securely anchored in Christ alone.
